title: Energy and Movement
seo_title: Grade 5 Natural Sciences and Technology: Energy and Movement Worksheets (CAPS)
standard_code: Grade 5 Natural Sciences and Technology: Energy and movement; systems for moving things
standard_text: Moving things have energy. Elastic bands and springs store energy that can make things move. Systems for moving things use wheels and axles, and forces such as pushes, pulls and friction change how things move. (summary of CAPS Natural Sciences and Technology, Grade 5, Energy and Change: Energy and movement; systems for moving things)
meta_desc: Free Grade 5 Natural Sciences and Technology worksheets (CAPS): energy in moving things, elastic bands and springs, wheels and axles, and pushes, pulls and friction. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Stretched elastic bands and springs store energy.
key_sub: Wheels and axles make it easier to move loads.
body_html:
How to think about it

A moving object has energy of movement (kinetic energy). A stretched elastic band or a squashed spring stores energy; when it is let go, the energy makes something move, as in a catapult or a wind-up toy.

A wheel and axle makes it easier to move heavy loads, as in wheelbarrows, carts and cars. Pushes and pulls start, stop and change the direction of moving things. Friction slows moving things down; smooth surfaces and round wheels reduce friction.

Example

A rubber band is stretched more. What happens to the energy it stores?

More stretch

Answer: it stores more energy

Example

Why does a ball roll further on a smooth floor than on grass?

Which surface has less friction?

Answer: there is less friction

Common mistakes

  • Thinking friction always helps movement.
  • Thinking heavier objects always move faster.
  • Thinking a spring stores energy without being squashed or stretched.

items.q: A learner eats breakfast and then runs to school. Which shows the main energy conversion?
items.e: A learner eats breakfast and then runs to school: chemical potential energy → kinetic energy.

items.q: A solar panel on an HDB rooftop produces electricity. Which shows the main energy conversion?
items.e: A solar panel on an HDB rooftop produces electricity: light energy → electrical energy.

items.e: A wind turbine turns to produce electricity: kinetic energy → electrical energy.
